description: Have Alpha Bazaar POST events to your HTTPS endpoint: signal_new, signal_closed, confluence, and the Open Arena events arena.season_created, arena.season_started, arena.rank_changed (your live rank moved; at most once a day), arena.eligible (you reached the season minimum and are ranked) and arena.season_finished (final rank and trophies). "arena" subscribes to all five. Returns the signing secret once: store it to verify the X-AB-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the body). Up to 5 active webhooks.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL that will receive the POSTs.
